title: Merge entries
description: Merges one entry into another so the two become one entry, as Merge Entry does in FieldWorks: the merged entry's senses, grammatical info and alternate forms move to the entry that stays, its lexeme form joins the other's or becomes an alternate form, and every reference to it points at the entry that stays; Motif stages a Draft for a person to review and Apply. It refuses an entry merged into itself or an id that is not an entry.
